name: royal-cache-film
description: THE ROYAL CACHE — a programmatically animated 9:16 documentary short built with Remotion.

scripts.assets: node scripts/gen-textures.mjs && node scripts/gen-audio.mjs && node scripts/build-cues.mjs
scripts.render: node scripts/ensure-assets.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts RoyalCacheFilm out/royal-cache.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.still: node scripts/ensure-assets.mjs && remotion still src/index.ts RoyalCacheFilm out/still.png
scripts.render:clean: node scripts/ensure-assets.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts RoyalCacheFilm out/royal-cache-clean.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --props='{"subtitles":false,"voiceover":true,"music":true,"foley":true,"voVolume":1,"musicVolume":0.55,"foleyVolume":0.6}'
